Theorem 5.1 ([?, Theorem 5.1, p. 3]). Let \(P\) be a subquiver of a quiver \(Q\) and \(w\) a weighting of \(P\). The extension of \(w\) by zero is balanced on \(Q\) if and only if \(w\) is balanced on \(P\). In particular the cycle space of \(P\) is a saturated sublattice of the cycle space of \(Q\), of rank \(|A(P)| - |V(P)| + c(P)\).
